name: Barrow Key
summary: Deep beneath Stonetalon Peak, the Barrow Key lies locked in the Talon Den. It is one of three druidic keys guarding the ancient treasures sealed within the den's hoard.

sections.title: A Guardian's Safeguard
sections.body: Night elf druids placed wards throughout the Talon Den's underground barrows to protect their relics from intruders. The Barrow Key is hidden in a cache among the passages, one part of that layered defense. The cache opens only with the Gatekeeper's Key, so a seeker must know the druids' defenses to reach it.

sections.title: Unlocking the Hoard
sections.body: The Barrow Key, the Claw Key, and the Sleepers' Key fit three carved keyholes in a stone altar deep in the Talon Den. Turn all three together, and the protective enchantments fade. The druidic relics in the hidden hoard are then within reach.

faq.q: What is the Barrow Key used for?
faq.answer: The Barrow Key works with the Claw Key and the Sleepers' Key to open the Talon Den Hoard, a stone chest of protected druidic relics deep within Stonetalon Peak.

faq.q: Where is the Barrow Key hidden?
faq.answer: The Barrow Key is locked inside a barrow cache deep in the Talon Den's winding tunnels on Stonetalon Peak. The cache resembles a concealed wall torch.

faq.q: How do you open the cache containing the Barrow Key?
faq.answer: You need the Gatekeeper's Key to open the cache. The druids hid it in a small lantern near the Talon Den's main entrance.

faq.q: Who hidden the Barrow Key in the Talon Den?
aliases: who hid the keys in talon den
faq.answer: Night elf druids living in Stonetalon Peak devised the den's elaborate defenses to keep their powerful artifacts from hostile hands. They concealed the keys in different parts of the den.

angles.text: As a druid, you know the Barrow Key belongs to an ancient security rite. The druids of the Talon Den designed it to protect sacred belongings in their underground sanctuary.
Horde operatives in Stonetalon Mountains pry information from captured night elves to find the Barrow Key and plunder the druids' private hoard.
